steps.label: Liveness check

Load a closed thin-slab STL (12 triangles) as a static mesh fluid boundary (top surface at y=-1, spanning x,z in [-5,5]) -- must be closed/watertight, not an open sheet, for LevelSet's ray-parity inside/outside test to be well-defined
Precondition: mesh boundary loaded with the expected triangle count
PBSPH
Small effect length
Low stiffness
Rest density
Particle radius
Small time step

Zero gravity -- isolates the mesh boundary's SDF penalty force from gravity/multi-particle pressure dynamics (broader PBSPH multi-step settling stability is a separate, pre-existing concern -- see 15_fluid_pbsph_dam_break.json)
Single particle seeded 0.05 below the mesh floor's top surface (y=-1), i.e. already penetrating
Domain container walls, far enough away to never interfere
Rebuild fluid (also re-registers the mesh boundary on the fresh solver)
Precondition: exactly one particle seeded
Precondition: starts penetrating the floor
Change: mesh boundary's SDF penalty pushes the penetrating particle back out
Pushed back above its start depth, without exploding
Clear the mesh boundary
Triangle count drops to 0
Rebuild fluid (reregisterMeshBoundary() is a no-op once the boundary shape is cleared -- see FluidWorld.h)
Precondition: re-seeded at the same penetrating depth
Same duration, but with no boundary left to push back
Invariant: with zero gravity and no boundary, an isolated particle has no force acting on it at all -- it does not move
